A cluster merges both workspaces: services (platform workloads) and hcps (hosted control planes, per-HCP ocm-* namespaces). Requests/limits/usage are summed across a workload's pods & containers; per-cluster namespaces (ocm-*, klusterlet-*) are normalized so families aggregate. Workloads are attributed to the AKS node pool their pods run on (system / infra / user). Usage is each pod's sustained percentile, summed over currently-running pods.
